title: focus-swarm data shapes
$comment: personas.json is {run: Run, personas: [Persona]}. Each agent writes one AgentReport to agents/<id>.json. Every persona is fictional unless real_person is true, which only happens when the user turned on real-people research for that panel.

id.description: panel id + two-digit index, e.g. general01, capital12, marketing03

role.description: job or situation; for capital, the title

org.description: fund, company or lab; expected for research and capital

language.description: the language this persona would actually use

device.description: phone, old laptop, desktop; drives how the agent tests

history.description: the short life story that explains this person's bias

lens.description: the one angle no other persona covers

seat.description: the seat from the panel's seats list this persona fills, if the panel has seats

current_tool.description: commercial panel: the tool this would have to replace

real_person.description: true only when the user enabled real-people research for this panel; the profile is then built from public sources and everything the agent says is a simulation

research_notes.description: real-person profiles only: what public sources established (thesis, portfolio, papers, stated positions), with links in sources

stage_focus.description: capital only, e.g. pre-seed to seed

visited.description: false means the agent could not reach the target. Such a report is excluded from synthesis.

visit_method.description: how the agent reached the target: a real browser, plain HTTP fetches, reading files, or reading a document

evidence.description: what the agent actually did: pages opened, actions taken, files read

public_record.description: Real-person profiles only. Verbatim public statements with their source, never model-generated. Rendered apart from said and unsaid.

first_10s.description: stream of consciousness in their voice

journey.description: ordered account of what they did and what happened

score.description: could this person complete the product's main promise unaided. Not whether they liked it.

friction.description: things that cost effort but did not stop them

said.description: SIMULATED. What they would say out loud, quotable, in their register.

unsaid.description: SIMULATED. What they noticed and would not say, what they would never admit, what their behaviour says instead of their words.

deal.description: capital panel only. No blanks, no 'it depends'.

valuation.description: pre-money or range they would accept; if NO, the valuation that would reopen it

instrument.description: SAFE, convertible note, equity, grant, revenue share, LOI

offers.description: concrete non-money value: named doors, hires, customers

wants.description: what they want to happen to the company

refuses.description: what they would not let happen

board_terms.description: board seat, observer, pro-rata, information rights

extra.description: panel-specific block for panels other than capital and research, one entry per field declared in the panel's extra_block; rendered generically by the board

value.description: object for kv, array for list, string for text, boolean for bool, integer for int

prior_art.description: named work, with links where they exist

panels.description: panel id -> headcount, straight from run.config.json

panel_order.description: display order for the board; defaults to picker order

real_people.description: panel ids for which the user turned on real-people research; empty means every persona is fictional

notes.description: what the user asked the swarm to watch for

lang.description: report language; personas may still speak their own language
